apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- arcade tests: accept the name as typed where the filesystem ignores case
- DriverPacks: Manager::GetAvailability uses the manager's own platform
- catalog tests: rename the tar.gz test entry so it stops clashing with TarEntry
- SHA256: include 7-Zip's Sha256.h with angle brackets
- Screenshot harnesses: describe them without naming tools outside this tree
- Library: a switch to leave a game folder's subfolders out
- Library: icons keep animating when one of them leaves the screen
- Android: gyro aim lets go of the sensor while the app is out of sight
- Android: Discord idles while the app is out of sight
- Library: stop drawing while the app is out of sight
- Android: the paused CPU thread sleeps while the app is out of sight
- Android: let go of the audio device while the app is out of sight
- Oboe: keep a paused stream paused when it reopens
- Big Picture: list the Arcade Setup page title for translation
- Qt: reloading a game's settings after an online patch install can no longer leave the settings window empty
- Qt: Apply & Restart on the GPU Drivers page asks about and cancels a driver install in progress
- Big Picture: resuming a game closes the memory card backups window
- Big Picture: shutting down no longer waits on a texture pack's hit POST or its directory walk, and leaves another UI's cover run alone
- Windows projects: list the online-packs sources in pcsx2 and common
- Memory card backups: tell the player when an unreadable card could not be offered for restore
- Texture packs: an install made from a game's settings switches replacement on there too when the game turns it off
- Memory card backups: only the boot's reopen takes snapshots, and the default is off on libretro and iOS too
- GPU Drivers page: listed only where driver packs exist or a pack is installed or selected
- Driver packs and arcade boot files: the test-load child closes inherited descriptors, a boot-files digest mismatch fails
- Texture packs: the zip extractor bounds the total it writes and checks free space first
- Big Picture: texture packs, drivers and arcade setup ask the network only after the page has stayed open for a second
- Autosave: an autosave a crash left set aside as .drop is put back when its slot is empty
- Texture packs: an install keeps a replacements folder it did not make, and never follows a symlink when deleting
- Catalog: parse JSON iteratively so deeply nested input cannot overflow the stack
- Arcade: an .acgame whose dongle, card or SRAM names leave their folder is refused
- Qt: the game list type filter keeps each type's enum value so Arcade no longer selects Invalid
- Big Picture: loading a state of an arcade game with no game running prepares the game first
- Big Picture: cover style and region choices read their captures before closing the dialog
- Qt: GPU Drivers page for downloading and choosing a Vulkan driver pack (Linux)
- Qt: Texture Packs page over the online catalog, with a button in Texture Replacement
- Qt: automatic cover download with its settings and per-game region
- Qt: in Big Picture mode, Big Picture asks whether to restore an unreadable memory card
- Big Picture: Texture Packs page with the online catalog, pack details, installs with progress and cancel, and installed packs, plus a Browse Texture Packs row in the Texture Replacement section
- Big Picture screenshots: gamesettings:<page> opens the first game's settings on that page, so a per-game page can be shot
- Qt UI: autosaves in the Load State menu, with interval, count and on-shutdown settings in Advanced
- Qt UI: memory card backups dialog, an Automatic backups setting, and the boot-time restore question
- Qt UI: Browse Online on the Patches and Cheats pages searches the community repositories and installs what the player ticks
- Qt UI: System > Arcade has Insert Coin for each player, Service and Test for a running arcade game
- Qt UI: an Arcade Controls page remaps a controller's buttons on an arcade game's cabinet, for one game or for all of them
- Big Picture screenshots: gamesettings:<page> opens a page of the first game's settings, and :browse starts the online patch search
- Big Picture: Browse Online row on the Patches and Cheats pages that searches the community repositories and installs the picked entries
- Qt UI: an arcade game is made ready before it starts, and an .acgame opens from Start File and drag and drop
- Qt UI: Tools > Arcade Setup shows the boot files, the arcade BIOS and which arcade games are ready
- Big Picture: GPU Drivers settings page with the driver in use, a choice of system driver or installed pack, downloads with progress and cancel, delete, and Restart Now
- Big Picture: memory card backups window and restore question, autosave tiles in the Load State list, and the autosave settings
- Big Picture: arcade setup page, per-game arcade controls, pause menu submenu, and games started through Prepare
- GameList: the image of an arcade game with no .acgame is a game
- Qt: Local Link as an Ethernet device type on the Network & HDD page
- Memory cards: a fallback slot for the restore prompt handler, so the host's own dialog wins over Big Picture's
- Catalog: a one-shot answer one thread waits on while another supplies it, for questions asked while the VM starts
- Qt UI: -uishot renders a settings page, a dialog or the main window to a PNG on the offscreen platform
- Big Picture: automatic cover download after the game list settles, with toggle, style and region rows, a per-game region pin and progress notifications
- Big Picture: Local Link as an Ethernet device type, with host, address, port, peer ID and room code rows and the DHCP rows hidden
- Big Picture: texture upscale row (Off, RAISR 2x, RAISR 4x) in the Texture Replacement section of the Graphics page
- Big Picture screenshots: a rescan page and the settings of the first game, so pages that need a game list can be reached
- Memory cards: back them up before they open at boot, restore with rollback, offer to restore an unreadable one
- Autosave: a rotating history of autosaves, an interval timer and save on shutdown
- Catalog: a file-operations interface so multi-step changes on disk can be tested with a failing step
- Config: settings for autosave interval, count and save on shutdown, and for memory card backups
- Catalog: Local Link settings rules shared by the UIs, with the room code upper-cased before it is stored
- Hosts: apply the selected GPU driver pack right after the settings load
- DriverPacks: list, install, apply and delete GPU driver packs on Linux
- Catalog: a defensive .tar.gz extractor for downloaded packs
- Catalog: texture-pack installer, and the seam that makes an installed pack take effect
- Catalog: tar+zstd and zip extractors for texture packs, with the archive path policy
- Catalog: texture-pack catalog from the one textures.json, popularity counter, installed-pack record
- Catalog: ask for compressed responses unless the caller picked an encoding
- Arcade: ArcadeSetup gets an arcade game ready to boot and says what it still lacks
- GameList: an arcade game's boot program, image and dongle are no longer listed as games
- Catalog: online patch and cheat browser that searches the community repositories and installs the chosen sections
- Catalog: split .pnach files into sections and append sections to an existing file
- SDL: --headless WxH renders to an offscreen image, and -bigpicture is accepted
- PINE: UIOpenPage, UIWaitFrames and UIScreenshot drive Big Picture with no display
- GS: a host with no window can get an offscreen present and read it back
- Catalog: automatic cover download for game-list entries with no cover
- Catalog: cover download job that remembers 404s on disk and backs off on a rate limit
- Catalog: cover URLs per platform and style, and a region index built from the game database
- BIOS: arcade board dumps no longer show in the console BIOS lists
- GameList: arcade games listed from their .acgame files
- Hotkeys: coin for each player, Service and Test for an arcade game
- Input: an arcade game's controller input drives the JVS board, not the DualShock
- Arcade: map a controller onto the cabinet's JVS switches for every control mode
- Catalog: atomic file writes, an on-disk response cache and JSON helpers
- Catalog: a fetch layer with https-only redirects, byte caps, streaming to file and a fake for tests
- Tests: add the catalog_tests target with SHA-256 vectors and a fixtures directory
- Common: add a streaming SHA-256 hasher on the vendored 7-Zip implementation
- GameDB: Gran Turismo 4 reads its readback asynchronously on mobile
- Android: a game whose GPU driver was deleted uses the global driver
- Android: don't strand RunOnCPUThread callers when the VM thread exits
- Android: rumble every controller assigned to a player
- Android: show what the game runs, red for non-defaults, readable marks
- Android: tint settings rows the game database sets or the player changed
- Android: one rule for whether a game database entry is in force
- Android: enable ANGLE from per-game settings
- Android: the Renderer tab's Reset also clears the Graphics API, GPU driver and ANGLE

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261008...0076b5c389ea7296331ad2d96193c6e8d5d314fa
